name: tree-sitter-memetic-wikitext
description: The CARRIER grammar of memetic-wikitext — sigil forms, fences, headings, TW5 lists — parsed generically; the sigil VOCABULARY is live wiki data, never grammar

artifact.toolchain: tree-sitter-cli >=0.26.1 builds wasm via auto-downloaded wasi-sdk; no emscripten pin. The CLI that generates and the runtime that loads never drift a minor apart (the pin-pair law).

scripts.gates: pnpm run gate:generate-parity && pnpm run gate:fold && pnpm run gate:fold-ts
scripts.release:bundle: pnpm run gates && pnpm run build:wasm && node tools/bundle-release.mjs
